title: How Lorton’s I-95 Dust and Occoquan Humidity Load Your Air Ducts
headline: Laurel Hill HOAs, Lorton Station stacks, and why river air plus interstate grit stick
description: Lorton, VA sits on I-95 south of Springfield with the Occoquan nearby. Learn why traffic dust and river humidity load ducts, and when to book a cleaning from Burke.

sections.heading: Lorton is Springfield’s problem, one exit south — plus a river
paragraphs: Lorton Station and the VRE, Laurel Hill on the former prison grounds, Gunston-area streets, and older Lorton Road houses share I-95 air. Traffic film is constant. The Occoquan and nearby creeks add a humid mass that the Mixing Bowl does not quite match. New townhomes and 1970s split-levels fail the same way: cool trunks, wet air, dusty returns.
You can wipe a register after a weekend. Monday’s commute puts gray film back on the supply that faces the interstate.

sections.heading: Lorton Station dryers pack at the roof cap
paragraphs: Laurel Hill and Station HOAs stack laundry and send lint up a long chase. A dryer that needs two cycles is usually packed at a roof cap, not a dying machine. That moisture sits in the same envelope as Occoquan-humid trunks.
If supplies look dirty a few days after you wipe them, start with [air duct cleaning in Lorton, VA](/locations/lorton).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Lorton house
listItems: Gray film on supplies facing I-95 or Richmond Highway.
Musty air from a split-level basement after rain over the Occoquan.
Two-cycle dry times in a Lorton Station or Laurel Hill townhome.

sections.heading: Burke is up the road — not a Station mailbox
paragraphs: Lorton is served from our [Burke](/locations/burke) office. Nearby [Springfield](/locations/springfield) and [Mount Vernon](/locations/mount-vernon) use the same crew. There is no Lorton storefront.
Book on the [Lorton location page](/locations/lorton). Pair stacked laundry with [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning).
listItems: Change filters more often if you back up to I-95.
Keep basement humidity under 50% in summer.
Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear HOA dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: Does I-95 dust really reach Lorton indoor ducts?
faq.a: Yes. Fine traffic particles settle near the house. Returns pull them in with river humidity. Cleaning the ducts removes what filters never caught.

faq.a: From Burke. Springfield is a nearby page on the same dispatch. There is no Lorton office.
